# 1-year or 2-year? Compare the Section 174A R&E catch-up election.

> Free calculator for the Section 174A domestic R&E catch-up deduction (OBBBA, Rev.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
